rozhrani.meta.titulek: CzechPatrol — security overview for Czechia and Europe
rozhrani.meta.popis: An independent overview of documented security incidents in Czechia and around it. Every entry has a date, a place and a source you can open.
rozhrani.strojove.upozorneni: This is a machine translation. The Czech version is the authoritative one.
rozhrani.co.text: An independent overview of documented security incidents in Czechia and its surroundings. Every entry has the date of the event, a place and a source you can open.
rozhrani.co.neni: It is not an official warning and does not replace one. Official information is issued by state authorities.
rozhrani.nikdy.zdroj: We never publish a claim without a traceable source.
rozhrani.nikdy.cesta: We never advise anyone where to travel or not to travel.
rozhrani.nikdy.varovani: We never use the wording, names or symbols of state warning systems.
rozhrani.uroven.hodnoceni: This is our assessment, not a fact and not an official finding.
rozhrani.uroven.stupnice: The scale has six levels: Low, Slightly elevated, Moderate, Elevated, High, Serious.
rozhrani.udalosti.zadne: There is no verified entry for the period shown.
rozhrani.overovani.sber: Every half hour we read public feeds from authorities, news agencies and newsrooms.
rozhrani.overovani.clovek: A person opens the sources and checks what actually happened. Official sources come first.
rozhrani.overovani.zverejneni: Only then is the entry published. The date of the event and the date it was first reported are kept apart.
rozhrani.overovani.neovereno: Automatically captured reports that nobody has verified are kept separate and are never counted.
rozhrani.odber.telegram: Verified entries go out on Telegram as soon as they are published.
